theorem substOldPostSubset:
  (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars (P:=Expression)
    (substOld h2 (Lambda.LExpr.fvar m h1 ty) post)).Subset
    (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars (P:=Expression) post ++ [h1]) := by
  dsimp [Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars]
  intro
  fun_induction substOld
  with_reducible
    any_goals apply List.mem_append_left
    all_goals
      simp only [Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars, List.mem_append] at *
      repeat' first | assumption | apply Or.inr | refine or_or_distrib_right.2 ∘ Or.imp ?_ ?_

lemma fundamental_theorem_of_variational_calculus' {f : Y → V}
    (μ : Measure Y) [IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ] [μ.IsOpenPosMeasure]
    [OpensMeasurableSpace Y]
    (hf : Continuous f) (hg : ∀ g, IsTestFunction g → ∫ x, ⟪f x, g x⟫_ℝ ∂μ = 0) :
    f = 0 := by
  ext x₀
  by_contra hx
  have hp := real_inner_self_nonneg'.lt_of_ne' (inner_self_eq_zero'.not.mpr hx)
  have hc := hf.inner' (𝕜 := ℝ) f (fun _ => f x₀) continuous_const
  obtain ⟨φ, hs, hk, hd, hr, he⟩ := exists_contDiff_tsupport_subset
    (hc.continuousAt.preimage_mem_nhds (Ici_mem_nhds hp))
  exact ((hd.continuous.mul hc).integral_pos_of_hasCompactSupport_nonneg_nonzero
    hk.mul_right (fun x => if hx : φ x = 0 then (mul_eq_zero_of_left hx _).ge
      else mul_nonneg (hr (Set.mem_range_self x)).1 (hs (subset_closure hx)))
    (mul_ne_zero (ne_zero_of_eq_one he) hp.ne')).ne' (by
      simpa only [inner_smul_right', Pi.mul_apply] using hg _ ((IsTestFunction.mk hd hk).smul_right (contDiff_const (c := f x₀))))

lemma time_deriv_time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema {A : ElectromagneticPotential d}
    {𝓕 : FreeSpace}
    (hA : ContDiff ℝ ∞ A) (J : LorentzCurrentDensity d)
    (hJ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ J) (h : IsExtrema 𝓕 A J)
    (t : Time) (x : Space d) (i : Fin d) :
    ∂ₜ (∂ₜ (A.electricField 𝓕.c · x i)) t =
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * ∑ j, (∂[j] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i)) x) -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂[i] (J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t ·) x -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * 𝓕.μ₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
  have hJ1 := hJ.differentiable (by simp)
  have hA3 : ContDiff ℝ 3 A := hA.of_le ENat.LEInfty.out
  have hEs j : ContDiff ℝ 2 (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j) :=
    electricField_apply_contDiff_space hA3 t
  have hEd := fun j k => Space.deriv_differentiable (hEs j) k
  have hB j := magneticFieldMatrix_contDiff (n := 2) (c := 𝓕.c) A hA3 (j, i)
  have hb j := Space.time_deriv_comm_space_deriv (i := j) (hB j) t x
  simp only [time_deriv_magneticFieldMatrix _ hA3.of_succ,
    Space.fun_deriv_sub _ _ (hEd i _) (hEd _ i),
    fun j => @Space.deriv_commute ℝ d j i _ _ _ (hEs j)] at hb
  have hg := congrFun (congrArg (Space.deriv i)
    (funext fun y => ((isExtrema_iff_gauss_ampere_magneticFieldMatrix hA J hJ).mp h t y).1)) x
  simp only [div_eq_mul_inv, Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis] at hg
  unfold Space.div at hg
  erw [fderiv_fun_sum (fun j _ => (hEd j j).differentiableAt),
    fderiv_mul_const (LorentzCurrentDensity.chargeDensity_differentiable_space
      hJ1 t).differentiableAt] at hg

  conv_lhs =>
    enter [1, s]
    rw [Time.deriv_euclid (electricField_differentiable_time
      hA3.of_succ _), time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema hA J hJ h]
  have hd := ((HasFDerivAt.fun_sum (u := Finset.univ) fun j _ =>
    (Space.space_deriv_differentiable_time (i := j) (hB j) x t).hasFDerivAt).const_mul
      (1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀))).fun_sub
    ((LorentzCurrentDensity.currentDensity_apply_differentiable_time (c := 𝓕.c)
      hJ1 x i t).hasFDerivAt.const_mul (1 / 𝓕.ε₀))
  simp only [Time.deriv_eq, hd.fderiv, ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
    smul_eq_mul, FunLike.coe_sum, Finset.sum_apply,
    ← Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis] at hg ⊢
  simp only [← Time.deriv_eq, hb, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, hg, FreeSpace.c_sq, mul_comm 𝓕.ε₀ 𝓕.μ₀, mul_inv_rev,
    div_eq_mul_inv, mul_sub, mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel_left₀ 𝓕.μ₀_ne_zero, one_mul]

lemma ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_eq_time {φ ψ : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp}
    (hφψ : crAnTimeOrderRel φ ψ) (hψφ : crAnTimeOrderRel ψ φ) (a b : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) :
    ι 𝓣ᶠ(a * [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * b) =
    ι ([ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * 𝓣ᶠ(a * b)) := by
  let T := (ι (𝓕 := 𝓕)).toLinearMap.comp timeOrderF
  let C := [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF
  let M := LinearMap.mul ℂ 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra
  apply LinearMap.congr_fun₂ (f := (M.comp (LinearMap.mulRight ℂ C)).compr₂ T)
    (g := M.compr₂ ((LinearMap.mulLeft ℂ (ι C)).comp T))
  apply LinearMap.ext_basis ofCrAnListFBasis ofCrAnListFBasis
  intro φs' φs
  dsimp only [LinearMap.compr₂_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.mulRight_apply,
    LinearMap.mulLeft_apply, LinearMap.mul_apply', AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply, T, C, M]
  simp only [ofListBasis_eq_ofList]
  let S := List.insertionSort crAnTimeOrderRel (φs' ++ φs)
  let E := fun c => crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ
  let L := List.takeWhile (fun c => ¬crAnTimeOrderRel φ c)
    S ++
    List.filter E φs'
  let R := List.filter E φs ++
    List.filter (fun c => crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ ¬crAnTimeOrderRel c φ)
    S
  have split (l : List 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp)
      (hl : ∀ c ∈ l, E c :=
        by simp [E, hφψ, hψφ, crAnTimeOrderRel_refl]) :
      crAnTimeOrderList (φs' ++ (l ++ φs)) = L ++ (l ++ R) := by
    rw [crAnTimeOrderList, ← List.append_assoc, insertionSort_of_eq_list _ _ _ _ _ hl]
    simp only [L, R, List.append_assoc]
    rfl
  calc
    _ = crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ φ :: ψ :: φs) •
        (ι (ofCrAnListF L) * ι C * ι (ofCrAnListF R)) := by
      conv_lhs =>
        rw [superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF]
        simp [mul_sub, sub_mul, ← ofCrAnListF_singleton, ← ofCrAnListF_append]
        rw [timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF, timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF]
      simp only [map_smul]
      erw [← crAnTimeOrderSign_swap_eq_time hφψ hψφ, split [φ, ψ], split [ψ, φ]]
      simp only [List.cons_append, List.nil_append, C, superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF,
        ofCrAnListF_append, ofCrAnListF_cons,
        map_mul, map_sub, map_smul, mul_sub, sub_mul, mul_smul_comm,
        smul_mul_assoc, mul_assoc]
      rw [smul_sub, smul_comm]
    _ = _ := by
      rw [Subalgebra.mem_center_iff.mp (ι_superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF_mem_center φ ψ)]
      rw [mul_assoc, ← map_mul, ← ofCrAnListF_append]
      erw [← split []]
      by_cases hq : (𝓕 |>ₛ ψ) = (𝓕 |>ₛ φ)
      · rw [crAnTimeOrderSign, Wick.koszulSign_eq_rel_eq_stat _ _ hφψ hψφ hq,
          ← crAnTimeOrderSign, ← ofCrAnListF_append, timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF]
        simp only [List.nil_append, map_smul, mul_smul_comm]
      · simp only [ι_superCommuteF_of_diff_statistic (Ne.symm hq), zero_mul, smul_zero]

theorem fiberwise_dist_lt_imp_dist_lt_unique_decoding_radius (i : Fin ℓ) (steps : ℕ)
    [NeZero steps] (h_i_add_steps : i.val + steps ≤ ℓ)
    (f : OracleFunction 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩)
  (h_fw_dist_lt : fiberwiseClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    (i := i) (steps := steps) (h_i_add_steps := h_i_add_steps) (f := f)) :
  hammingClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩ f := by
  classical
  let d := fiberwiseDistance 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f
  obtain ⟨⟨g, hg⟩, _, hd⟩ := Nat.sInf_mem (s :=
    (fun g : BBF_Code 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) i.castSucc => (fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g.1).ncard) '' Set.univ)
    ⟨_, 0, trivial, rfl⟩
  have hb : hammingDist f g ≤ d * 2 ^ steps := by
    rw [show d = _ from hd.symm]

    simp_rw [Set.ncard_eq_toFinset_card', ←Finset.card_fin (2 ^ steps), ←Finset.card_product]
    apply Finset.card_le_card_of_surjOn (fun p => (qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β _ steps
      (Nat.lt_add_of_pos_right_of_le _ _ _ h_i_add_steps)) p.1 p.2)
    intro x hx
    refine ⟨(_, _), ?_, (is_fiber_iff_generates_quotient_point 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps x _).mp rfl⟩
    exact Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨Set.mem_toFinset.mpr
      ⟨x, rfl, (Finset.mem_filter.mp hx).2⟩, Finset.mem_univ _⟩
  have hn : 2 * hammingDist f g < BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 i.castSucc := by
    have hh := Nat.mul_le_mul_right (2 ^ steps) (Nat.le_of_lt_succ (ENat.coe_lt_coe.1 h_fw_dist_lt))
    rw [Nat.mul_assoc] at hh
    have hh := (Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 hb).trans hh
    dsimp [BBF_CodeDistance] at hh ⊢
    rw [Nat.sub_mul, ←Nat.pow_add, ←Nat.pow_add] at hh
    simp only [Nat.sub_add_eq,
      Nat.sub_add_cancel (Nat.le_sub_of_add_le' (h_i_add_steps.trans (Nat.le_add_right ℓ 𝓡))),
      Nat.sub_add_cancel (Nat.le_sub_of_add_le' h_i_add_steps)] at hh
    exact Nat.lt_succ_of_le hh
  exact (mul_le_mul_left' (Code.distFromCode_le_dist_to_mem f g hg) 2).trans_lt (ENat.coe_lt_coe.2 hn)

theorem fiberwise_dist_lt_imp_dist_lt_unique_decoding_radius (i : Fin ℓ) (steps : ℕ)

    ⟨_, 0, trivial, rfl⟩

    change Finset.card _ ≤ _
    simp_rw [Set.ncard_eq_toFinset_card', ←Finset.card_fin (2 ^ steps), ←Finset.card_product]
    apply Finset.card_le_card_of_surjOn (fun p => qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β _ steps
      (Nat.lt_add_of_pos_right_of_le _ _ _ h_i_add_steps) p.1 p.2)
    intro x hx
    refine ⟨(_, _), ?_, (is_fiber_iff_generates_quotient_point 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps x _).mp rfl⟩
    exact Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨Set.mem_toFinset.mpr
      ⟨x, rfl, (Finset.mem_filter.mp hx).2⟩, Finset.mem_univ _⟩
  have hn : 2 * hammingDist f g < BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 i.castSucc := by
    have hh := Nat.mul_le_mul_right (2 ^ steps) (Nat.le_of_lt_succ (ENat.coe_lt_coe.1 h_fw_dist_lt))
    rw [Nat.mul_assoc] at hh
    have hh := (Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 hb).trans hh
    dsimp [BBF_CodeDistance] at hh ⊢
    rw [Nat.sub_mul, ←Nat.pow_add, ←Nat.pow_add] at hh
    simp only [Nat.sub_add_eq,
      Nat.sub_add_cancel (Nat.le_sub_of_add_le' (h_i_add_steps.trans (Nat.le_add_right ..))),
      Nat.sub_add_cancel (Nat.le_sub_of_add_le' h_i_add_steps)] at hh

  exact (mul_le_mul_left' (Code.distFromCode_le_dist_to_mem f g hg) 2).trans_lt (ENat.coe_lt_coe.2 hn)

theorem putnam_1995_a3
(relation : (Fin 9 → ℤ) → (Fin 9 → ℤ) → Prop)
(digits_to_num : (Fin 9 → ℤ) → ℤ)
(hdigits_to_num : digits_to_num = fun dig => ∑ i : Fin 9, (dig i) * 10^i.1)
(hrelation : ∀ d e : (Fin 9 → ℤ), relation d e ↔ (∀ i : Fin 9, d i < 10 ∧ d i ≥ 0 ∧ e i < 10 ∧ e i ≥ 0) ∧ (∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ (digits_to_num (fun j : Fin 9 => if j = i then e j else d j))))
: ∀ d e f : (Fin 9 → ℤ), ((relation d e) ∧ (relation e f)) → (∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ d i - f i) := by
  have replace (a b : _ → _) i :
      digits_to_num (fun j => if j = i then b j else a j) =
        digits_to_num a + (b i - a i) * 10^i.1 := by
    apply eq_add_of_sub_eq'
    simp only [hdigits_to_num, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← sub_mul,
      ite_sub, sub_self, ite_mul, Fintype.sum_ite_eq']
  intro d e f h i
  simp only [hrelation, replace] at h
  choose k hk using h.1.2
  obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := h.2.2 i
  apply (show IsCoprime (7 : ℤ) 10 by decide).pow_right |>.dvd_of_dvd_mul_right
  use (∑ j, k j) - digits_to_num d - k i - l
  simp only [mul_sub, Finset.mul_sum, ← hk, ← hl, sub_mul, Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_sub_distrib,
    Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul]
  rw [hdigits_to_num]
  ring1
